lines.text: Google's Kubernetes servers kept timing out, and the cause was hiding in three places.
About 800 developers were blocked from deploying to production.
lines.title: The impact

lines.text: Packet captures showed the server replying to new connections with stale replies from old, closed ones.
lines.title: What the captures showed

lines.text: Three causes worked together: packet reordering, Envoy's half-close behavior, and a Linux kernel bug.
lines.title: Three causes

lines.text: The kernel threw away some out-of-order FIN packets, leaving sockets stuck in FIN_WAIT_2.
lines.title: Stuck forever

lines.text: Google rolled back a change, fixed the proxy, and patched the kernel. Fixes reached GKE 1.33.5 and later.
lines.title: The fixes

lines.text: Takeaway: small, reasonable behaviors in different layers can combine into one big failure. Packet captures reveal it.
lines.title: Takeaway
